summary: Solo ski mountaineer Matt Randall caught a ski on a rock at the top of South Maroon Peak's east face and tumbled roughly 1,000 feet down a steep snow couloir; he walked away with only scratches and bruises and self-rescued with no SAR involvement.
location: South Maroon Peak, east face snow couloir
notes: Mentioned in a comment on the 2023-12-30 Capitol/Pyramid thread; near-miss with no injuries and no rescue; date per the subject's own caption (May 10, 2022); also covered in Sharp End Podcast ep 88.
